Hello, world! I develop open-source tools that fix the limitations of traditional spatial tools when applied to archipelagos. My years in public office and studies of statistics near the Cebu Port Authority has deeply grounded my work so that they meet the reality of archipelagic life.

Outside work, I've founded [PinasR](https://pinasr.r-universe.dev/packages), a centralized repository for R packages made by Filipinos. You may find my core spatial tools at [CRAN.](https://www.r-pkg.org/maint/ninotalingting77@gmail.com)
